entities.summary: Juwono Sudarsono was an Indonesian diplomat and the author of works on political science and international relations. He was educated at the University of Indonesia, Jakarta ; The Institute of Social Studies, The Hague, the Netherlands; the University of California, Berkeley, USA (M.A.); and the London School of Economics, UK (Ph.D.). He was later an Emeritus Professor at the University of Indonesia.
